name: reframe
description: Expand or reframe an existing video to a new aspect ratio while preserving the source content. Use this when the user asks to make a video vertical, horizontal, square, wider, taller, or fill new edges around a video. Pass medias with exactly one source video and aspect_ratio for the target canvas. Optional image references can guide the filled area; optional start_image can pin the first frame when the user provides a first-frame anchor. For source videos over 15 seconds, pass duration_seconds and resolution and use only the source video. This tool does not use prompt or count. Set params.get_cost=true to estimate credits without submitting a job.

aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio. Required unless get_cost is true.

duration_seconds.description: Source video duration in seconds. Required with resolution when the source video is over 15 seconds. Maximum supported duration is 60 seconds.

resolution.description: Required when get_cost is true or duration_seconds is over 15 seconds. Allowed values: 480p, 720p, 1080p.

medias.description: Required unless get_cost is true. Exactly one source video, optional one start_image, and optional 1-2 image references. For videos over 15 seconds, pass only the source video.

value.description: Source video. Confirmed uploaded video media_id or completed video job_id.
Optional image. Confirmed uploaded image media_id or https:// image URL.

role.description: Use image for references that guide filled edges. Use start_image only when the user provides a first-frame anchor.

get_cost.description: If true, return the cost in credits for this reframe without submitting any job. Requires duration_seconds and resolution; medias and aspect_ratio are not needed.

params.description: Video reframe parameters. prompt and count are not supported.
